title: cassipourea elliottii
intro: Cassipourea elliottii, commonly known as African Star Chestnut, is a plant species belonging to the family Ochnaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimalarial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
